en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sahl Bin Al Yas’a, from his father who said,
‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the woman dyeing (her hair) and she is menstruating. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no prolem with it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sahl ibn al-Yasa’ from his father who has said the following: “
I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a woman who uses dye during her Hayd (menses). He (the Imam) said, ’It is not harmful.”’
